verdict.rationale: The project ships all three paths the story names: a skill-creator meta-skill "for creating new skills and iteratively improving them" (including benchmarking and description optimization), a template SKILL.md, and a published Agent Skills spec defining required frontmatter and directory layout. Packaging and distribution are documented through plugin manifests, local `--plugin-dir` testing, marketplaces, and Skills API upload, and a user reports having Claude Code create and organize skills. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an agent running skill-creator through to a packaged or uploaded skill (the runtime probe only installed skill-creator), and explicit documentation that the meta-skill itself handles the packaging step.
